heavy.name: Heavy pockets
heavy.text: Pockets full of coins: every reach leans more.

slippery.name: Slippery shoes
slippery.text: New shoes: slow to stop, slow to start.

hiccups.name: Hiccups
hiccups.text: Somebody in the coat has the hiccups.

short.name: Coat too short
short.text: The coat shrank in the wash: grown-ups notice faster.
